# FarmerRoutes — Graph-Based Routes/Paths for WoW

**FarmerRoutes** is a reimagined routing system for World of Warcraft (Forever, Classic Era, and TBC Classic). Unlike traditional routing addons that use linear arrays of waypoints, FarmerRoutes uses a **graph-based data model**. This allows for natural branching, intersections, and loops, making it the perfect tool for complex farming routes (Gas Clouds, Herbs, Ore, and Treasure).

---

## Key Features

*   **Graph-Based Architecture**: Build complex, non-linear routes with interconnected nodes and edges.
*   **World Map Editor**: Edit your routes directly on the World Map with intuitive mouse controls.
*   **Smart Navigation HUD**: A draggable directional arrow and distance readout with predictive "look-ahead" logic to guide you seamlessly through your route.
*   **Minimap Overlay**: Zoom-aware, lines that provide a visual path without cluttering your minimap.
*   **Advanced Styling & Inheritance**: Granular control over node and edge visuals with a 3-tier inheritance model (Global → Route → Item).
*   **Sync & Sharing**: Import/Export routes via strings. Fully compatible with legacy RoutePlanner strings.
*   **Multi-Character Support**: Manage routes across all your characters with bulk import capabilities.
*   **Smart Bulk Updates**: Changing route-level styles automatically propagates to all nodes and edges matching the previous defaults.
*   **Fluid Map Interaction**: Integrated map panning and high-priority click detection ensure seamless editing even over dense resource icons.

---

## How to Use

### Map Editor Controls
Enter **Edit Mode** by clicking the wrench icon on the World Map toolbar.

*   **Ctrl + Left-Click (Empty Space)**: Add a new node and connect it to the selected node.
*   **Left-Click (Node)**: Select a node or drag to reposition it.
*   **Ctrl + Left-Click (Existing Node)**: Create or remove an edge between the selected node and the clicked node.
*   **Shift + Left-Click (Edge)**: Split an edge by inserting a new node in the middle.
*   **Right-Click (Node/Edge)**: Delete the targeted element.
*   **Right-Click (Empty Space)**: Clear selection or zoom out map.

### Navigation HUD
Toggle the HUD to get directional guidance to your next farm node.
*   **Shift + Left-Click (Minimap Button)**: Quickly toggle the HUD on/off.
*   **Draggable Interface**: Click and drag the HUD to reposition it anywhere on your screen.
*   **Smart Logic & Look-Ahead**: The HUD automatically detects your direction of travel and targets the most logical next node. When within 20 yards of a target, it automatically "looks ahead" to the next node in the sequence for seamless navigation.

### Slash Commands
*   `/fr` — Open main settings.
*   `/fr import <string>` — Import a route from a string.
*   `/fr export <route name>` — Generate an export string for a route.

---

## Styling System

FarmerRoutes uses a powerful inheritance model for visuals:
1.  **Global Default**: Set the default look for all routes in the main settings.
2.  **Route Default**: Override style for a specific route via the Style Drawer.
3.  **Item Override**: Set a unique color or size for a specific node or edge for high-priority waypoints.

Access the **Style Drawer** by clicking the gear icon on the World Map toolbar while a route is selected.

# FarmerRoutes

## [v1.3.1](https://github.com/malkamius/FarmerRoutes/tree/v1.3.1) (2026-11-24)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/malkamius/FarmerRoutes/commits/v1.3.1) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/malkamius/FarmerRoutes/releases)

- chore(release): v1.3.1  
- ci: add GitHub/CurseForge release workflow  
- chore(deploy): add \_forever\_ client target  
- feat(map): add WoW Forever support and fix map toolbar layout  
    - Add support for WoW Forever (Camelot interface 16001), including  
      dedicated TOC and flavor detection.  
    - Anchor the World Map edit button to SidePanelToggle on WoW Forever to  
      prevent overlap with the quest log counter when quests are expanded.  
    - Anchor the bottom edit toolbar to WorldMapFrame.ScrollContainer and  
      align to BOTTOM, keeping it stable when quest log is shown/hidden or  
      when resizing/maximizing the map window.  
    - Modernize ColorPicker integration and update library compatibility.  
- feat(map): improve visual consistency of map rendering  
    - Respect configured node and edge colors during selection and editing.  
    - Use route-level style colors for node borders instead of hardcoded overrides.  
    - Fix selected node border color (changed from cyan to high-visibility yellow).  
    - Ensure consistent line thickness and transparency based on style definitions.  
    - Register ColorPickerFrame in VSCode global diagnostics.  
- fix(minimap): sync minimap visibility on route toggle  
    - Update `Data.SetRouteVisible` and `Data.SetRouteColor` to trigger a  
      minimap refresh via `MarkDirty()`.  
    - Refactor map toolbar visibility toggle to use centralized data  
      helpers instead of direct state modification.  
- feat(map): enhance editor interactions and style propagation  
    - Implement selective mouse propagation in Edit Mode to allow map  
      panning while maintaining click priority on nodes and edges.  
    - Add "Smart Propagation" for style changes: updating route-level  
      styles now automatically updates nodes and edges that match the  
      previous style or global defaults.  
    - Prevent accidental node deselection when panning by checking drag  
      distance.  
    - Fix right-click zoom-out behavior when interacting with nodes.  
    - Elevate editor click frame strata and level to prioritize addon  
      interactions over other map pins (e.g., GatherLite).  
    - Update style UI to track and pass previous style state for bulk  
      updates.  
- refactor(core): cleanup obsolete rendering settings  
    Following the migration to native line rendering, several variables in the default settings became obsolete. This commit removes them and tunes the remaining style parameters for the new renderer.  
    - Remove `dotSize`, `dotSpacing`, `lineThickness`, `waypointLabelSize`, and `smartInsertion` from default settings.  
    - Adjust default `nodeSize` to 5 and `edgeThickness` to 4 for optimal visibility with the line-based rendering system.  
- fix(ui): resolve nil value error in SettingsUI and update interface version  
    Fixes a Lua error occurring when deleting routes or creating new ones in the Settings UI where `RefreshUI` was called as a global instead of using the `UI.Refresh` namespace.  
    - Fix: Replace erroneous `RefreshUI()` calls with `UI.Refresh()` in `ui/SettingsUI.lua`.  
    - Style: Update default node alpha from 1.0 to 0.5 in `core/Init.lua` for better visual layering on the map.  
    - Docs: Refine README title and update "High-Fidelity Minimap" description to "Minimap Overlay".  
    - Build: Bump `Interface` version to 20505 and `Version` to 1.0.4.  
- docs: remove banner image and clean up header formatting in README  
- perf(minimap): implement AABB early-out culling for offscreen edges  
    Implement an early-out bounding box check for minimap route rendering to drastically improve CPU performance on long routes.  
    - Pre-calculate bounding boxes (minX, maxX, minY, maxY) for all edges in world coordinates during route recalculation.  
    - Apply Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) checks in the OnUpdate loop against the player's position and current minimap radius.  
    - Culled edges completely bypass trigonometric rotation, pixel scaling, and mathematical circle/rectangle intersection algorithms.  
- fix(minimap): correct rotation math and add square minimap support  
    The previous line-rendering logic contained a sign error when applying the rotation matrix during minimap rotation (using `-facing`), causing lines to rotate in the opposite direction of the map. This has been corrected to use `facing`, matching the expected native orientation.  
    Additionally, because we recently removed `AddMaskTexture` in favor of mathematical circle clipping, lines were artificially cropped into a circular shape when users had square minimap replacements installed (like ElvUI or SexyMap). This update introduces a fallback Liang-Barsky rectangle clipping algorithm that dynamically activates if `GetMinimapShape()` indicates the active minimap is not `ROUND`, perfectly supporting all common UI overhauls.  
- perf(minimap): switch to native lines for rendering routes  
    The previous dot-based interpolation strategy created thousands of `Frame` objects to render route edges on the minimap. These were individually tracked by `HereBeDragons-Pins`, resulting in thousands of trig calculations every frame, causing a huge spike in CPU usage.  
    This refactors `MinimapRenderer` to use WoW's native `CreateLine` textures instead, drastically reducing the active minimap object count to a single line per edge. Additionally, because `Line` textures do not support `AddMaskTexture` in the WoW API, this implements a 2D mathematical circle intersection algorithm to precisely clip lines and prevent them from bleeding beyond the minimap radius.  
- feat(ui): enhance Navigation HUD and route import workflow  
    - Improve Navigation HUD:  
        - Implement automatic target-switching (look-ahead) when within 20 yards of a node.  
        - Make HUD frame draggable with saved persistence.  
        - Add right-click to hide and subtle hover background/border.  
        - Add "Reset Position" button in Settings.  
    - Streamline Route Import:  
        - Functionalize Map Toolbar import button to link directly to character sync.  
        - Add "Import All" button to character sync tab for bulk route migration.  
        - Expose `ShowTab` utility in Settings UI for deep linking.  
- Initial commit - Core concepts & data model, UI/Visuals, Import/Export, Styles, Navigation HUD
